ns2:course.label: Instrumental Methods for Secondary Ensembles
ns2:course.description: Surveys repertoire for secondary wind and string ensembles; develops administrative skills for organizing a school music program; increases skills in rehearsal techniques and addresses current issues in music education. Prerequisite: MUS 240, MUS 350; or approval of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 240, MUS 350; or approval of instructor.
